question: Which transmission medium is least susceptible to electromagnetic interference?
explanation: Optical fibre data को light के through transmit करता है न कि electrical signals के through, इसलिए यह EMI (Electromagnetic Interference) से practically immune होता है।

question: Which guided medium provides the highest available bandwidth?
explanation: Optical fibre terahertz range में bandwidth support करता है। यह सबसे high-bandwidth guided medium है।

question: In a coaxial cable, what is the correct order of layers from innermost to outermost?

options.text: Outer jacket → Braided shield → Insulator → Inner conductor
Inner conductor → Insulator → Braided shield → Outer jacket
Insulator → Inner conductor → Braided shield → Outer jacket
Inner conductor → Braided shield → Insulator → Outer jacket

explanation: Coaxial cable की layers अंदर से बाहर: copper inner conductor → insulating layer → metallic braided shield → plastic outer jacket।

question: Which twisted-pair variant uses foil shielding around the entire cable bundle?
explanation: FTP में पूरे cable bundle के ऊपर एक aluminium foil होती है। STP में individual pairs पर shield होती है। दोनों UTP से better interference protection देते हैं।
